svg.desc: Utopia Pharmaceutical Factory LOCATION 10th of Ramadan, Egypt CLIENT Utopia Pharmaceuticals COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2022 320 million EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview The project covers an area of 18,300 m2, encompassing five buildings with total area of 17,000 m2: including production and administration buildings in addition to the utilities building. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings and site supervision. The multidisciplinary services covered landscape design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
